headline: Mooring County Erupts in Clashes as Weathered Expanse Grinds On
war_summary: Since our previous edition, Mooring County has surged to the forefront of active combat, logging six base transitions and more than seventeen hundred casualties in the past two hours alone. That flurry around Gravekeeper's Holdfast and Wiccwalk has consolidated Warden control across eleven strategic bases against a single Colonial outpost. Weathered Expanse remains intensely contested, yielding two further base actions and a thousand casualties over two hours, leaving three redoubts ruined in no-man's-land alongside five Warden strongholds and one Colonial position. Further east, Palantine Berm saw five base turnovers over the six-hour mark before settling entirely into Warden hands, while Nevish Line has paused its frantic territorial flips despite continuing heavy attrition that claimed over seven hundred lives in two hours. Meanwhile, the bloody struggle in Callahan's Passage has abated dramatically, tumbling from earlier massive clashes to just seventy-three total casualties in the latest two-hour interval. Marban Hollow, Kuura Strand, and Fishermans Row remain stagnant, showing negligible engagement along their stabilized perimeters.
